summary: Declared-surface coverage completion and recording. FRONTEND_COVERAGE.json now has one row for each of the 107 declared constructs (280 parameters), every row implemented with per-construct executed evidence and the IR construct that carries it (51 shared carriers, 2.1 constructs per carrier: 13 dtype constants -> tir.Type, 12 math forms -> math.*, 7 reductions -> reduce, 6 reshape-family -> reshape, 6 atomics -> atomic_rmw/cas, 6 RNG -> rng.philox, 3 arith fn forms -> arith.*); recorded through the engine frontend-coverage command (evaluate ok=true) and cross-checked by a new coverage-matrix check inside the declared enumeration test. Closing the gaps required real implementation work the full-corpus census exposed: tl.static_assert (the last unimplemented construct with corpus calls: constexpr-true emits nothing, false/runtime conditions are located refusals; its 3 corpus operators now lower), tl.dtype (the pinned name-registry constructor, the f'uint{nbits}' JoinedStr form, .primitive_bitwidth folding on x.dtype and ptr.type.element_ty; its 2 corpus operators now clear the frontend), the .cast method form of tl.cast (24 cases), meta-carried live triton dtype objects in dtype= (tl.cast/tl.zeros/tl.full, 27 cases), module-level X = tl.constexpr(v) globals (10 cases), tl.fma's pinned to_tensor scalar legalization -- python-float scalars participate as fp32, which the gelu fp16 chain silently computed in 16-bit before (6 cases, now executed-and-compared PASS), .shape folding (attribute, subscript, evaluator; feeds tl.arange/tl.full constexpr shapes), and a pre-existing BoolOp leak where a runtime 'or' folded to the truthiness of the RuntimeValue objects (silently baking True; now a located refusal, the pinned visit_BoolOp logical_and/logical_or lowering left as a recorded T018 class). Evidence: the complete 30-file a100c test suite passes with 0 failed checks; end-to-end executed comparisons on the newly-enabled operators (selu_kernel_supreme [static_assert] and gelu_kernel_nomask [fma] all cases PASS at 1 and 4 threads under the case policies); the tl.dtype corpus operator refuses located at the lowering's i64-offset/i32-SEW width boundary (frontend complete, deeper stage owned by T018). Final full-corpus frontend census: 1873/2734 cases lower to verified TIR (1832 at task start); the 861 remaining refusals are 19 recorded shape-form/non-construct classes handed to T018. tl.swizzle2d (0 corpus calls) is implemented with executed evidence rather than declared-unsupported.
